records_captured: Each form's name in Japanese, Spanish, French and German (docs/upgrade-plan-2027q2.md, Q4)

fields.name: form_name
fields.description: The form's PokéAPI slug, matching data/staging/pokeapi.schema.json's form_name and resolving directly to pokemon_key

fields.name: language
fields.description: ja, es, fr or de. Portuguese isn't extracted: the Brazilian games use the English names

fields.name: localised_name
fields.description: The form's name in the language: PokéAPI's own full form name where it has one, else composed from the species name (see name_rule)

fields.name: name_rule
fields.description: How the name was produced: species, pokeapi_form, mega ("Méga-Dracaufeu Y"), form_label (species plus PokéAPI's form label), regional ("Arcanine de Hisui"), gender (a ♂/♀ sign), or fallback (species plus the English form label, where PokéAPI has no label in the language)

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: PokéAPI's full form names are uneven by language (French and Japanese Megas are complete, Spanish and German sparse), so most non-default forms are composed by pokeapi.localised_name; about ten Champions-pool rows fall back to an English form label in Spanish or German
